surface: Client runtime surface at @lingui/react 6.6.0: I18nProvider, useLingui, LinguiContext, Trans, and TransNoContext over @lingui/core@6.6.0. ./macro, ./server setI18n/getI18n, and react-server TransRsc are explicit gaps.
divergences: Public node and component types use OctaneNode and do not import React.
Locale subscription uses octane useSyncExternalStore rather than use-sync-external-store.
Trans component class components are not supported; pass a function component.
./macro and @lingui/babel-plugin-lingui-macro are compile-time and are not ported.
./server setI18n/getI18n depends on React.cache / RSC and is not ported.
react-server index-rsc / TransRsc is not ported.
ssr: I18nProvider reads the i18n snapshot through useSyncExternalStore (client and server snapshot are the same). Render is null until i18n.activate has set a locale. RSC setI18n/getI18n is an explicit gap.
